title: Examples we love
slide_intent: Introduce the range of media a designer will compare. An overview helps readers choose the application closest to their communication problem.
strategic_value: Repeated assets across print, digital and physical pieces can establish continuity while allowing each format its own composition.
demonstration: A cyan page gathers a tote, publications, digital screens and campaign fragments around the introduction. The left index names the application types covered in the following pages.
practical_value: Use the medium list to move from a general brand question to a relevant worked application.

content_islands.name: Application index
content_islands.spec: Use the chapter rail to list advertising, digital, social, event, print, correspondence and presentation pages.

content_islands.name: Example montage
content_islands.spec: Keep the intro clear at upper left, then distribute the tote and varied rectangular pieces across the cyan field at different sizes.
